newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz shares lead financials' advance.
newsitem.headline: Allianz shares lead financials' advance.

text.p: Insurance giant Allianz AG Holding led an advance among German financial shares late on Tuesday as a surge in the Bund market fuelled renewed interest in the sector.
Allianz shares were trading up 14.75 marks, or 4.6 percent, at 335.75 marks at 1424 GMT, well ahead of the market average increase of 1.6 percent.
Other financials were also ahead, with Deutsche Bank AG up 1.96 marks at 90.33 marks amid heavy trading volumes.
Dealers atributed the gains in the sector to a late rally in Bund prices on the back of softer than expected U.S. economic data, released in the early afternoon European time.
Allianz was benefiting in particular because of its enormous securities portfolio, dealers said.

"The sheer scale of these holdings, especially in fixed income are being reflected here," said BHF Bank banking and insurance analyst Dieter Hein, playing down suspicions that the gains might be connected to fresh speculation about mergers in the German financial sector.
Allianz itself said it had no idea why its share price was rising so strongly as it had not issued any new information in recent days.
